# CI for kt
```{r}
# Construct (per-year) Gaussian CI for kappa_t using RW-with-drift increments
# Returns a data frame: year, kappa, lower, upper
kappa_ci_df <- function(LCfit, alpha = 0.05, show_plot = TRUE) {
  # Extract kappa and years
  kappa <- as.numeric(LCfit$kt)
  years <- LCfit$years
  
  stopifnot(length(years) == length(kappa))
  if (length(kappa) < 2) stop("Need at least 2 years of kappa_t to estimate increments.")
  if (anyNA(kappa)) stop("kappa_t contains NA; please remove/impute before constructing CI.")
  
  # Increments (RW with drift): y_t = kappa_t - kappa_{t-1}
  y <- diff(kappa)
  
  # Drift estimate (not directly used in the per-year CI band below, but kept for completeness)
  theta_hat <- mean(y)
  
  # Innovations: omega_t = y_t - theta_hat
  omega_hat <- y - theta_hat
  
  # Innovation variance (MLE)
  sigma2_w_hat <- mean(omega_hat^2)
  sigma_w_hat  <- sqrt(sigma2_w_hat)
  
  # Gaussian CI (same width each year under this simple assumption)
  z <- qnorm(1 - alpha / 2)
  kappa_lower <- kappa - z * sigma_w_hat
  kappa_upper <- kappa + z * sigma_w_hat
  
  kt_df <- data.frame(
    year  = years,
    kappa = kappa,
    lower = kappa_lower,
    upper = kappa_upper
  )
  
  # plot
  p <- ggplot(kt_df, aes(x = year, y = kappa)) +
          geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.2) +
          geom_line() +
          labs(
            x = "Year",
            y = "kappa_t",
            title = paste0("GAPC Gaussian RW-based ",
               round((1 - alpha) * 100),
               "% CI for kappa_t (per year)")
          ) +
          theme_minimal()
  if (isTRUE(show_plot)) print(p) 
  
  return(kt_df)
}
```

# CI for CBD
```{r}
# Construct (per-time) Gaussian CI for CBD kappa1_t and kappa2_t
# using RW-with-drift increments (same style as your kappa_ci_df).
#
# Inputs:
#   CBDfit    : fitted StMoMo cbd object (must contain $kt and $years)
#   alpha     : significance level (default 0.05 -> 95% CI)
#   show_plot : TRUE/FALSE; if TRUE, plot kappa1 and kappa2 with CI bands
#
# Outputs:
#   list(kt_df1 = ..., kt_df2 = ...)  (both data.frames with year,kappa,lower,upper)

kappa_ci_df_CBD <- function(CBDfit, alpha = 0.05, show_plot = TRUE) {

  # --- Extract kappa1, kappa2 and years ---
  if (is.null(CBDfit$kt)) stop("CBDfit$kt is missing.")
  if (is.null(CBDfit$years)) stop("CBDfit$years is missing.")

  kappa1 <- as.numeric(CBDfit$kt[1, ])
  kappa2 <- as.numeric(CBDfit$kt[2, ])
  years  <- CBDfit$years

  stopifnot(length(years) == length(kappa1), length(years) == length(kappa2))
  if (length(years) < 2) stop("Need at least 2 time points to estimate increments.")
  if (anyNA(kappa1) || anyNA(kappa2)) stop("kappa contains NA; please remove/impute before constructing CI.")

  # --- RW-with-drift increments ---
  y1 <- diff(kappa1)
  y2 <- diff(kappa2)

  theta_hat1 <- mean(y1)
  theta_hat2 <- mean(y2)

  omega_hat1 <- y1 - theta_hat1
  omega_hat2 <- y2 - theta_hat2

  # Innovation variance (MLE)
  sigma_w_hat1 <- sqrt(mean(omega_hat1^2))
  sigma_w_hat2 <- sqrt(mean(omega_hat2^2))

  # --- Gaussian CI (same-width band under this simple assumption) ---
  z <- qnorm(1 - alpha / 2)

  kappa_lower1 <- kappa1 - z * sigma_w_hat1
  kappa_upper1 <- kappa1 + z * sigma_w_hat1

  kappa_lower2 <- kappa2 - z * sigma_w_hat2
  kappa_upper2 <- kappa2 + z * sigma_w_hat2

  kt_df1 <- data.frame(
    year  = years,
    kappa = kappa1,
    lower = kappa_lower1,
    upper = kappa_upper1
  )

  kt_df2 <- data.frame(
    year  = years,
    kappa = kappa2,
    lower = kappa_lower2,
    upper = kappa_upper2
  )

  # --- Optional plots (base R, similar to what you did before) ---
  if (isTRUE(show_plot)) {
    old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
    on.exit(par(old_par), add = TRUE)

    par(mfrow = c(2, 1), mar = c(5, 6, 3, 1))

    # kappa1
    plot(kt_df1$year, kt_df1$kappa, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
         ylim = c(min(kt_df1$lower), max(kt_df1$upper)),
         main = expression(kappa[t]^{(1)} ~ "with 95% CI"),
         xlab = "Year", ylab = expression(kappa[t]^{(1)}),
         cex.main = 2, cex.lab = 2, cex.axis = 1.3)
    lines(kt_df1$year, kt_df1$lower, col = "gray40", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
    lines(kt_df1$year, kt_df1$upper, col = "gray40", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
    legend("topright",
           legend = c("kappa1(t)", "95% CI"),
           col = c("black", "gray40"),
           lty = c(1, 2),
           lwd = 2, bty = "n")

    # kappa2
    plot(kt_df2$year, kt_df2$kappa, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
         ylim = c(min(kt_df2$lower), max(kt_df2$upper)),
         main = expression(kappa[t]^{(2)} ~ "with 95% CI"),
         xlab = "Year", ylab = expression(kappa[t]^{(2)}),
         cex.main = 2, cex.lab = 2, cex.axis = 1.3)
    lines(kt_df2$year, kt_df2$lower, col = "gray40", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
    lines(kt_df2$year, kt_df2$upper, col = "gray40", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
    legend("topright",
           legend = c("kappa2(t)", "95% CI"),
           col = c("black", "gray40"),
           lty = c(1, 2),
           lwd = 2, bty = "n")

    par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
  }

  return(list(kt_df1 = kt_df1, kt_df2 = kt_df2))
}
```

# Parameter Plot for LC
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
# Plot LC ax, bx, kt with (per-year) kappa CI lines
# - Input: LCfit
# - Output: graphs (side effect)
# - Internally calls kappa_ci_df(LCfit, show_plot = FALSE) to get kt_df
plot_lc_components_ci <- function(LCfit){
  # get CI df without plotting
  kt_df <- kappa_ci_df(LCfit, show_plot = FALSE)
  
  # robust year vector for kt plot (your original code uses colnames(LCfit$kt))
  kt_years <- as.numeric(colnames(LCfit$kt))
  if (anyNA(kt_years)) {
    # fallback if colnames are missing/non-numeric
    kt_years <- LCfit$years
  }
  
  oldpar <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(oldpar), add = TRUE)
  
  par(mfrow = c(3, 1), mar = c(5, 6, 3, 1))
  
  # ax
  plot(25:65, LCfit$ax, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
       main = expression(a[x] ~ "vs." ~ x),
       xlab = "Age", ylab = expression(a[x]),
       cex.main = 2, cex.lab = 2, cex.axis = 1.3)
  axis(1, at = seq(25, 65, by = 5), labels = seq(25, 65, by = 5), cex.axis = 1.3)
  
  # bx
  plot(25:65, LCfit$bx, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
       main = expression(beta[x]^{(1)} ~ "vs." ~ x),
       xlab = "Age", ylab = expression(beta[x]^{(1)}),
       cex.main = 2, cex.lab = 2, cex.axis = 1.3)
  axis(1, at = seq(25, 65, by = 5), labels = seq(25, 65, by = 5), cex.axis = 1.3)
  
  # kt with CI
  plot(kt_years, LCfit$kt[1, ], type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
       main = expression(kappa[t]^{(1)} ~ "vs." ~ t),
       ylim = c(min(kt_df$lower), max(kt_df$upper)),
       xlab = "Year", ylab = expression(kappa[t]^{(1)}),
       cex.main = 2, cex.lab = 2, cex.axis = 1.3)
  
  lines(kt_df$year, kt_df$lower, col = "gray40", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
  lines(kt_df$year, kt_df$upper, col = "gray40", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
  
  legend("topright",
         legend = c("kappa(t)", "95% CI"),
         col = c("black", "gray40"),
         lty = c(1, 2),
         lwd = 2,
         bty = "n")
  
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

# Parameter Plot for RH
```{r}
# Plot RHnp fit components + kappa CI band (base R)
# - Input: RHnp_fit (a fitted StMoMo RHnp object)
# - Uses:  kappa_ci_df(LCfit, alpha=0.05, show_plot=FALSE) that you already defined
# - Output: produces the plots (returns invisibly a list with kt_df + layout info)

plot_RHnp_with_kappa_CI <- function(RHnp_fit, alpha = 0.05) {
  # --- get kappa CI df (no ggplot shown) ---
  kt_df <- kappa_ci_df(RHnp_fit, alpha = alpha, show_plot = FALSE)

  # --- layout (same as your code) ---
  layout_mat <- matrix(c(1, 0,
                         2, 3,
                         4, 5),
                       nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)

  # keep old par settings so we can restore
  old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit({
    layout(1)
    par(old_par)
  }, add = TRUE)

  layout(layout_mat)
  par(mar = c(5, 6, 3, 1))

  ages <- RHnp_fit$ages/12

  # 1) ax
  plot(ages, RHnp_fit$ax, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
       main = expression(a[x] ~ "vs." ~ x),
       xlab = "Age", ylab = expression(a[x]), cex.main = 2,
       cex.lab = 2, cex.axis = 1.3)
  axis(1, at = seq(min(ages), max(ages), by = 5), 
       labels = seq(min(ages), max(ages), by = 5), cex.axis = 1.3)

  # 2) bx (beta^(1)_x)
  plot(ages, RHnp_fit$bx, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
       main = expression(beta[x]^{(1)} ~ "vs." ~ x),
       xlab = "Age", ylab = expression(beta[x]^{(1)}), cex.main = 2,
       cex.lab = 2, cex.axis = 1.3)
  axis(1, at = seq(min(ages), max(ages), by = 5), 
       labels = seq(min(ages), max(ages), by = 5), cex.axis = 1.3)

  # 3) kt (kappa^(1)_t) with CI
  t_years <- as.numeric(colnames(RHnp_fit$kt))/12
  kappa1  <- as.numeric(RHnp_fit$kt[1, ])

  plot(t_years, kappa1, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
       main = expression(kappa[t]^{(1)} ~ "vs." ~ t),
       ylim = c(min(kt_df$lower), max(kt_df$upper)),
       xlab = "Year", ylab = expression(kappa[t]^{(1)}), cex.main = 2,
       cex.lab = 2, cex.axis = 1.3)

  lines(t_years, kt_df$lower, col = "gray40", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
  lines(t_years, kt_df$upper, col = "gray40", lty = 2, lwd = 2)

  legend("topright",
         legend = c("kappa(t)", "95% CI"),
         col = c("black", "gray40"),
         lty = c(1, 3),
         lwd = 2,
         bty = "n")

  # 4) b0x (beta^(2)_x in RH notation in your code)
  plot(ages, RHnp_fit$b0x, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
       main = expression(beta[x]^{(2)} ~ "vs." ~ x),
       xlab = "Age", ylab = expression(beta[x]^{(2)}), cex.main = 2,
       cex.lab = 2, cex.axis = 1.3)
  axis(1, at = seq(min(ages), max(ages), by = 5), 
       labels = seq(min(ages), max(ages), by = 5), cex.axis = 1.3)

  # 5) gc (gamma_{t-x} vs cohort)
  cohorts <- as.numeric(names(RHnp_fit$gc))/12
  plot(cohorts, RHnp_fit$gc, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
       main = expression(gamma[t-x] ~ "vs." ~ t-x),
       xlab = "Cohort", ylab = expression(gamma[t-x]), cex.main = 2,
       cex.lab = 2, cex.axis = 1.3)

  invisible(list(kt_df = kt_df))
}
```

# Parameter Plot for CBD
```{r}
# Plot CBD kappa^(1) and kappa^(2) with CI (ggplot), with x-breaks built from data range
# - x_break_by controls the spacing of breaks (e.g., 5, 10, 20)
plot_CBD_kappa_CI_gg <- function(CBDfit, alpha = 0.05,
                                 x_break_by = 5,
                                 base_size = 12) {
  CBDfit$years <- CBDfit$years/12
  out <- kappa_ci_df_CBD(CBDfit, alpha = alpha, show_plot = FALSE)
  kt_df1 <- out$kt_df1
  kt_df2 <- out$kt_df2

  # Build breaks from data range
  year_min <- floor(min(c(kt_df1$year, kt_df2$year), na.rm = TRUE))
  year_max <- ceiling(max(c(kt_df1$year, kt_df2$year), na.rm = TRUE))
  x_breaks <- seq(year_min, year_max, by = x_break_by)

  p1 <- ggplot(kt_df1, aes(x = year, y = kappa)) +
    geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_line(aes(y = lower), color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "33") +
    geom_line(aes(y = upper), color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "33") +
    labs(
      x = "year",
      y = expression(kappa[t]^{(1)}),
      title = expression(kappa[t]^{(1)} ~ "vs. t")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks) +
    theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text    = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  p2 <- ggplot(kt_df2, aes(x = year, y = kappa)) +
    geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_line(aes(y = lower), color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "33") +
    geom_line(aes(y = upper), color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "33") +
    labs(
      x = "year",
      y = expression(kappa[t]^{(2)}),
      title = expression(kappa[t]^{(2)} ~ "vs. t")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks) +
    theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text    = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  gridExtra::grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol = 1)

  invisible(list(p1 = p1, p2 = p2, kt_df1 = kt_df1, kt_df2 = kt_df2, x_breaks = x_breaks))
}
```

# RH
```{r}
fit_RH_rr <- function(mort_data){
  max_try <- 10
  mort_data2 <- mort_data
  mort_data2$years <- mort_data$years *12
  mort_data2$ages <- mort_data$ages*12
  # --- track best successful attempt ---
  best_logLik <- -Inf
  best_fitRH <- NULL
  
  RHnp_mod <- rh(link = "log", cohortAgeFun = "NP")

  for (j in seq_len(max_try)) {
    # 1) Try fitting RH 
    fitRH_j <- tryCatch(
      fit(RHnp_mod, data = mort_data2,
          ages.fit = (25:65)*12, control = list(maxit = 200)),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  
    # 2) if fit error -> move on
    if (is.null(fitRH_j) || isTRUE(fitRH_j$fail)) next
    
    ll_j <- fitRH_j$loglik
    if (ll_j > best_logLik) {
    best_logLik <- ll_j
    best_fitRH <- fitRH_j
    }
    
    return(best_fitRH) 
  }
}
```

# CBD
```{r}
fit_CBD <- function(mort_data){
  N <- 1e6
  mort_data2 <- mort_data
  mort_data2$Dxt <- round(mort_data$Dxt * N)
  mort_data2$Ext <- round(mort_data$Ext * N)
  mort_data2$years <- mort_data$years*12
  CBD <- cbd(link = "logit")
  CBDfit <- fit(CBD, data =  central2initial(mort_data2), ages.fit = (25:65))
  return(CBDfit)
}
```

# Forecast 
```{r}
get_fc_rates_vec <- function(fc, ages) {
  r <- fc$rates
  if (is.null(dim(r))) {
    v <- r
  } else {
    v <- r[, 1]
  }
  v <- as.numeric(v)
  names(v) <- rownames(as.matrix(fc$rates)) %||% names(fc$rates) # optional, but safer

  # best: just reorder by ages using names when available
  if (!is.null(names(fc$rates)) || !is.null(rownames(as.matrix(fc$rates)))) {
    nm <- if (!is.null(names(fc$rates))) names(fc$rates) else rownames(as.matrix(fc$rates))
    names(v) <- nm
    v <- v[as.character(ages)]
  }
  v
}
```

## LC
### one month ahead
```{r}
## LC

lc_roll_1mo_forecast <- function(mort_data, start_year=2003, end_year=2021) {
  # fixed settings (same as your yearly code)
  ages_fit <- 25:65
  LC <- lc(link = "log", const = "sum")
  mort_data$ages <- ages_fit
  mort_data$Dxt <- mort_data$Dxt[ages_fit,]
  mort_data$Ext <- mort_data$Ext[ages_fit,]
  
  # evaluation months
  time_num <- mort_data$years
  eval_idx <- which(time_num >= start_year & time_num < end_year)
  # for 1-step ahead forecast, origin is previous month (index-based, robust)
  origin_idx <- eval_idx - 1
  
  eval_time   <- time_num[eval_idx]
  origin_time <- time_num[origin_idx]
  
  # forecast rate, output matrices
  mx_hat_lc_rw <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(ages_fit), ncol = length(eval_idx),
                       dimnames = list(as.character(ages_fit), as.character(eval_time)))
  
  mx_hat_lc_ar <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(ages_fit), ncol = length(eval_idx),
                       dimnames = list(as.character(ages_fit), as.character(eval_time)))

  for (i in seq_along(eval_idx)) {
    T <- origin_time[i]
    # fit LC with design experience year
    fitLC_f <- fit(LC, data = mort_data, ages.fit = ages_fit, years.fit = time_num[1:origin_idx[i]])
    # check convergence
    print(paste("Year:", T, fitLC_f$conv))
    # one step ahead forecast
    fcLC_rw <- forecast(fitLC_f, h=1, level=95)
    fcLC_ar <- forecast(fitLC_f, h=1, kt.method = "iarima", kt.order = c(1,0,0), level=95)
  
    # extract forecast rate
    mx_hat_lc_rw[, as.character(eval_time[i])] <- get_fc_rates_vec(fcLC_rw, ages_fit)
    mx_hat_lc_ar[, as.character(eval_time[i])] <- get_fc_rates_vec(fcLC_ar, ages_fit)
  }
  return(list(
  mx_hat_lc_rw = mx_hat_lc_rw,
  mx_hat_lc_ar = mx_hat_lc_ar,
  eval_time = eval_time,
  origin_time = origin_time
  ))
}
```

```{r}
library(parallel)

data_list <- list(
  Midwest   = Midwest_data,
  Northeast = Northeast_data,
  South     = South_data,
  West      = West_data
)

cl <- makeCluster(4)

# Export your two custom functions
clusterExport(cl, varlist = c("lc_roll_1mo_forecast", "get_fc_rates_vec"))

# Load StMoMo on each worker
clusterEvalQ(cl, library(StMoMo))

# Run all four at the same time
results <- parLapply(cl, data_list, lc_roll_1mo_forecast)

stopCluster(cl)
```

## CBD
### One month ahead
```{r}
## CBD
CBD_roll_1mo_forecast <- function(mort_data, start_year=2003, end_year=2021) {
  # fixed settings (same as your yearly code)
  ages_fit <- 25:65
  CBD <- cbd(link = "logit")
  N <- 1e6
  mort_data$Dxt <- round(mort_data$Dxt * N)
  mort_data$Ext <- round(mort_data$Ext * N)
  mort_data$years <- mort_data$years*12
  mort_data$ages <- ages_fit
  mort_data$Dxt <- mort_data$Dxt[ages_fit,]
  mort_data$Ext <- mort_data$Ext[ages_fit,]
  
  # evaluation months
  time_num <- mort_data$years
  eval_idx <- which(time_num >= start_year*12 & time_num < end_year*12)
  # for 1-step ahead forecast, origin is previous month (index-based, robust)
  origin_idx <- eval_idx - 1
  
  eval_time   <- time_num[eval_idx]
  origin_time <- time_num[origin_idx]
  
  # forecast rate, output matrices
  qx_hat_CBD <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(ages_fit), ncol = length(eval_idx),
                     dimnames = list(as.character(ages_fit), as.character(eval_time/12)))

  for (i in seq_along(eval_idx)) {
    T <- origin_time[i]
    # fit LC with design experience year
    fitCBD_f <- fit(CBD, data = central2initial(mort_data), ages.fit = ages_fit, years.fit = time_num[1:origin_idx[i]])
    # check convergence
    print(paste("Year:", T/12, fitCBD_f$conv))
    # one step ahead forecast
    fcCBD <- forecast(fitCBD_f, h=1, level=95)
  
    # extract forecast rate
    qx_hat_CBD[, as.character(eval_time[i]/12)] <- get_fc_rates_vec(fcCBD, ages_fit)
  }
  return(list(
  qx_hat_CBD = qx_hat_CBD,
  eval_time = eval_time/12,
  origin_time = origin_time/12
  ))
}
```

## RH
```{r}
rh_roll_1mo_forecast <- function(mort_data, start_year = 2003, end_year = 2021) {
  
  # ---- fixed settings ----
  ages_fit <- 25:65
  max_try  <- 10
  
  # scale to monthly units (same as fit_RH_rr)
  mort_data$years <- mort_data$years * 12
  mort_data$ages  <- mort_data$ages  * 12
  
  # update row names (ages) and column names (years) of Dxt and Ext
  rownames(mort_data$Dxt) <- as.character(mort_data$ages)
  colnames(mort_data$Dxt) <- as.character(mort_data$years)
  rownames(mort_data$Ext) <- as.character(mort_data$ages)
  colnames(mort_data$Ext) <- as.character(mort_data$years)

  # now subset to ages of interest
  ages_fit_mo <- ages_fit * 12
  mort_data$Dxt <- mort_data$Dxt[as.character(ages_fit_mo), ]
  mort_data$Ext <- mort_data$Ext[as.character(ages_fit_mo), ]
  # change the mort_data$ages
  mort_data$ages <- ages_fit*12
  
  # RH model definition
  RHnp_mod <- rh(link = "log", cohortAgeFun = "NP")
  
  # ---- evaluation months ----
  time_num   <- mort_data$years   # in monthly units now
  eval_idx   <- which(time_num >= start_year * 12 & time_num < end_year * 12)
  origin_idx <- eval_idx - 1
  
  eval_time   <- time_num[eval_idx]
  origin_time <- time_num[origin_idx]
  
  # yearly versions for output naming only
  eval_time_yr   <- eval_time   / 12
  origin_time_yr <- origin_time / 12
  
  # ---- initialize storage lists ----
  sum_list      <- vector("list", length(origin_time))
  names(sum_list) <- as.character(origin_time_yr)
  
  sum_list_best <- vector("list", length(origin_time))
  names(sum_list_best) <- as.character(origin_time_yr)
  
  # ---- output matrix ----
  mx_hat_rh_ar <- matrix(NA_real_,
                         nrow = length(ages_fit),
                         ncol = length(eval_idx),
                         dimnames = list(as.character(ages_fit),
                                         as.character(eval_time_yr)))
  
  # ---- rolling forecast loop ----
  for (i in seq_along(eval_idx)) {
    
    T_mo <- origin_time[i]       # origin in monthly units (for StMoMo)
    T_yr <- origin_time_yr[i]    # origin in yearly units (for naming)
    set.seed(296 + T_mo) 
    
    cat("\n--- Origin Year:", T_yr, "| Forecast Year:", eval_time_yr[i], "---\n")
    
    # data up to origin
    years_fit_mo <- time_num[1:origin_idx[i]]
    
    # yearly versions for naming
    years_fit_yr <- years_fit_mo / 12
    
    # cohorts for this origin (monthly units for computation, yearly for naming)
    cohorts_fit_mo <- (min(years_fit_mo) - max(ages_fit_mo)):(max(years_fit_mo) - min(ages_fit_mo))
    cohorts_fit_yr <- cohorts_fit_mo / 12
    
    # ---- column names in yearly units ----
    cn_i <- c(
      "conv", "fc_ok",
      paste0("ax_",    ages_fit),        # yearly ages 25:65
      paste0("bx1_",   ages_fit),
      paste0("bx2_",   ages_fit),
      paste0("kt_",    years_fit_yr),    # yearly kt
      paste0("gc_",    cohorts_fit_yr),  # yearly gc
      paste0("mx_fc_", ages_fit)         # yearly ages
    )
    
    # ---- initialize summary matrices for this origin ----
    sum_mat <- matrix(NA_real_,
                      nrow = max_try,
                      ncol = length(cn_i),
                      dimnames = list(paste0("iter_", 1:max_try), cn_i))
    
    sum_mat_best <- matrix(NA_real_,
                           nrow = 1,
                           ncol = length(cn_i),
                           dimnames = list("iter_1", cn_i))
    
    # ---- random restart ----
    best_loglik <- -Inf
    best_fc     <- NULL
    
    for (j in seq_len(max_try)) {
      # 1) try fitting
      fitRH_j <- tryCatch(
        fit(RHnp_mod,
            data      = mort_data,
            ages.fit  = ages_fit_mo,
            years.fit = years_fit_mo,
            control   = list(maxit = 200)),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      
      # 2) skip if failed
      if (is.null(fitRH_j) || isTRUE(fitRH_j$fail)) {
        sum_mat[j, "conv"]  <- 0
        sum_mat[j, "fc_ok"] <- 0
        next
      }
      
      # 3) fill parameters (index using monthly, name using yearly)
      # ax
      sum_mat[j, paste0("ax_", ages_fit)] <-
        as.numeric(fitRH_j$ax[as.character(ages_fit_mo)])
      
      # bx
      bx1 <- fitRH_j$bx
      bx2 <- fitRH_j$b0x
      sum_mat[j, paste0("bx1_", ages_fit)] <-
        as.numeric(bx1[as.character(ages_fit_mo), 1])
      sum_mat[j, paste0("bx2_", ages_fit)] <-
        as.numeric(bx2[as.character(ages_fit_mo)])
      
      # kt (convert column names from monthly to yearly)
      ky_mo <- as.integer(colnames(fitRH_j$kt))
      ky_yr <- ky_mo / 12
      sum_mat[j, paste0("kt_", ky_yr)] <- as.numeric(fitRH_j$kt[1, ])
      
      # gc (convert names from monthly to yearly)
      gc       <- fitRH_j$gc
      gc_names_yr <- as.integer(names(gc)) / 12
      sum_mat[j, paste0("gc_", gc_names_yr)] <- as.numeric(gc)
      
      # 4) check convergence
      conv_j <- isTRUE(fitRH_j$conv)
      sum_mat[j, "conv"] <- as.numeric(conv_j)
      if (!conv_j) {
        sum_mat[j, "fc_ok"] <- 0
        next
      }
      
      # 5) try forecasting
      fcRH_j <- tryCatch(
        forecast(fitRH_j, h = 1, kt.method = "mrwd", gc.order = c(1, 1, 0)),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      
      if (is.null(fcRH_j)) {
        sum_mat[j, "fc_ok"] <- 0
        next
      }
      
      # 6) record forecast status and rates (index monthly, name yearly)
      sum_mat[j, "fc_ok"] <- 1
      sum_mat[j, paste0("mx_fc_", ages_fit)] <-
        as.numeric(fcRH_j$rates[as.character(ages_fit_mo)])
      
      # 7) update best
      ll_j <- fitRH_j$loglik
      if (ll_j > best_loglik & !is.null(fcRH_j)) {
        best_loglik  <- ll_j
        best_fc      <- fcRH_j
        sum_mat_best[1, ] <- sum_mat[j, ]
        
        # store forecast rates with yearly column name
        mx_hat_rh_ar[, as.character(eval_time_yr[i])] <-
          get_fc_rates_vec(best_fc, ages_fit)
      }
    }
    
    # store summary matrices using yearly origin as key
    sum_list[[as.character(T_yr)]]      <- sum_mat
    sum_list_best[[as.character(T_yr)]] <- sum_mat_best
  }
  
  # ---- return ----
  return(list(
    mx_hat_rh_ar  = mx_hat_rh_ar,
    eval_time     = eval_time_yr,
    origin_time   = origin_time_yr,
    sum_list      = sum_list,
    sum_list_best = sum_list_best
  ))
}
```

```{r}
rh_roll_1mo_forecast(Midwest_data)
```

```{r}
library(parallel)

# ---- four datasets in a named list ----
data_list <- list(
  Midwest   = Midwest_data,
  Northeast = Northeast_data,
  South     = South_data,
  West      = West_data
)

# ---- set up cluster ----
cl <- makeCluster(4)

# ---- export everything workers need ----
clusterExport(cl, varlist = c(
  "rh_roll_1mo_forecast",  # main function
  "get_fc_rates_vec"       # helper function called inside
))

# ---- load StMoMo on each worker ----
clusterEvalQ(cl, library(StMoMo))

# ---- run in parallel ----
results <- parLapply(cl, data_list, rh_roll_1mo_forecast)

stopCluster(cl)

# ---- extract results ----
RH_Midwest   <- results$Midwest
RH_Northeast <- results$Northeast
RH_South     <- results$South
RH_West      <- results$West
```
